fusions.name: Wrenched Bar
fusions.desc: Hurls a bar torn loose for 8 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Stunned] for 1 second. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Rattle the Hinges
fusions.desc: Shakes the ground around you, dealing 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 2.5 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Chest Beat
fusions.desc: Beats your chest and pulls up to 5 enemies within 7 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Breakout
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 35%, your physical damage rises by 40% for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
